q.en: The Deputy Prime Minister of India is appointed:

options.en: By convention; the post is not mentioned in the Constitution
options.as: প্ৰথা অনুসৰি; পদটো সংবিধানত উল্লেখ নাই

explanation.en: The office of Deputy Prime Minister is not mentioned in the Constitution and is a convention.
explanation.as: উপ-প্ৰধানমন্ত্ৰীৰ পদ সংবিধানত উল্লেখ নাই আৰু ই এক প্ৰথা।
